metadata_system.name: Camera Roll Photo Library
metadata_system.spec_source: JEITA CP-3461 (DCF — Design rule for Camera File system) + iOS/Android conventions
metadata_system.description: Camera Roll structure follows DCF (Design rule for Camera File system, JEITA CP-3461) — the international standard for how digital cameras name and organize files on storage media. The /DCIM root directory holds subdirectories named NNNAAAAA (e.g. 100APPLE, 100ANDRO, 100CANON), and files inside follow AAAANNNN.EXT (4-char prefix + 4-digit sequence + 3-char extension). iOS and Android both follow DCF for camera captures but add their own conventions (E/O prefixes for edits, BURST/MP suffixes for special modes, AAE sidecars for iOS edits, MotionPhoto XMP for Pixel). This entry documents the directory layout, filename patterns, vendor prefix conventions, companion files (THM, XMP, LRV, AAE), DPOF print orders, vendor catalog folders, and the inherited EXIF/MakerNote metadata that lives inside every DCIM image.

attribute.name: /DCIM/
attribute.description: Mandatory root directory for digital camera images per DCF (JEITA CP-3461)

attribute.name: /DCIM/100ANDRO/
attribute.description: DCF 8.3 directory: NNNAAAAA where NNN=100-999, AAAAA=5-char alphanumeric. Examples: 100APPLE, 101APPLE, 100MEDIA, DCIM/Camera (Android non-DCF)

attribute.name: Filename pattern: AAAANNNN.EXT
attribute.description: 4 alphanumeric + 4-digit sequence + 3-char extension. e.g. IMG_1234.JPG, DSC00123.JPG, P1010001.JPG

attribute.name: /DCIM/MISC/
attribute.description: Misc DPOF (Digital Print Order Format) files (AUTPRINT.MRK)

attribute.name: /PRIVATE/<vendor>/...
attribute.description: Vendor-specific data (DCF 2.0 PRIVATE area)

attribute.name: AUTPRINT.MRK (DPOF)
attribute.description: Print order — selected images, copies, sizes

attribute.name: Companion file: <basename>.THM
attribute.description: JPEG thumbnail accompanying RAW or video

attribute.name: Companion file: <basename>.XMP
attribute.description: XMP sidecar for non-XMP-aware formats (RAW, etc.)

attribute.name: Companion file: <basename>.LRV
attribute.description: Low-resolution proxy video (GoPro, DJI)

attribute.name: Companion file: <basename>.AAE
attribute.description: iOS edit-history sidecar — adjustments, crop, filter

attribute.name: Volume label
attribute.description: Often set by camera (e.g. 'CANON_DC', 'NIKON D850', 'EOS_DIGITAL')

attribute.name: /MISC/MISC.CTG
attribute.description: Some cameras: catalog file

attribute.name: /DCIM/CANONMSC/
attribute.description: Canon thumbnail/index database

attribute.name: EXIF Make/Model/Software
attribute.description: See system 045 — every DCIM image carries full EXIF

attribute.name: EXIF DateTimeOriginal
attribute.description: Capture timestamp in camera's local time (no TZ until EXIF 2.31)

attribute.name: EXIF OffsetTimeOriginal (EXIF 2.31)
attribute.description: Time zone offset for capture

attribute.name: EXIF GPS sub-IFD
attribute.description: See system 046 for full GPS tags

attribute.name: MakerNote
attribute.description: Vendor proprietary — see system 047 for 11,781 tags across 50+ vendors

attribute.name: iOS: /DCIM/100APPLE/IMG_NNNN.HEIC
attribute.description: Default iPhone capture path

attribute.name: iOS: /DCIM/100APPLE/IMG_NNNN.MOV
attribute.description: Live Photo motion file (paired with HEIC by Asset Identifier)

attribute.name: iOS: /DCIM/100APPLE/IMG_E1234.HEIC
attribute.description: 'E' prefix = Edited version (saves edit alongside original)

attribute.name: iOS: /DCIM/100APPLE/IMG_O1234.HEIC
attribute.description: 'O' prefix = Original (less common)

attribute.name: Android: /DCIM/Camera/IMG_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jpg
attribute.description: Default Android camera filename pattern (timestamp)

attribute.name: Android: /DCIM/Camera/PXL_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSSnnn.jpg
attribute.description: Google Pixel pattern (PXL prefix)

attribute.name: Android: /DCIM/Camera/IMG_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_BURSTnn.jpg
attribute.description: Burst photos — sequential BURST suffix, _COVER for primary

attribute.name: Android: /DCIM/Camera/PXL_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSSnnn.MP.jpg
attribute.description: Pixel Motion Photo — single file with embedded video

attribute.name: Android: Motion Photo XMP namespace 'GCamera'
attribute.description: GCamera:MotionPhoto, GCamera:MicroVideo, GCamera:MicroVideoOffset (in EXIF/XMP)

attribute.name: File access time on SD card (FAT/exFAT)
attribute.description: Last-access date typically preserved when copied; can corroborate viewing history

attribute.name: Sequence gaps
attribute.description: Missing IMG_NNNN suggests deleted images

attribute.name: Mismatch between EXIF DateTime and filename timestamp
attribute.description: Possible clock manipulation or file manipulation

attribute.name: Volume serial number (FAT)
attribute.description: Identifies specific SD card across re-formats
